data.name: LIMB.INC
data.detailed_description:
LIMBO IS NOT THE END. IT'S YOUR JOB.

LIMB.INC is a signal-like job simulator all about connecting souls to their most prized possessions.

Combine a Phantom File with its unique item in order to save (or damn) the soul right in front of you.

Earn enough money to buy cosmetics from the LIMB.OS Computer, all while uncovering hidden lore and secrets as you progress.

You're going to need every cue you can get in order to save as many souls as possible, and survive the day in the worst job in the Underworld.

And remember: the office is never empty! So watch out for any entity that tries to disturb your shift.

Keep your sanity high by ordering pills from the Store! Customize your desk with stickers, pets, and cool stuff found in the Computer! Answer the door to receive deliveries, turn in reports, clock out of work, and more... Always trust your instinct, for LIMBO is not the end.

GAME FEATURES

  • Signal-like Horror aesthetic;

  • Highly addictive gameplay loop;

  • Immerse yourself in the dark dithered underworld of LIMB.INC. Enjoy detailed, hand-crafted PSX-esque art with its industrial soundtrack that will lock you in to the worst first day of work of your life;

  • Uncover multiple endings and secrets based on your in-game decisions;

  • Beware of your sanity! The walls have eyes and ears;

  • Make use of the LIMB.OS computer to buy perks, cosmetic items, and more!

  • Prepare to work! LIMB.INC expects you by monday.

data.short_description: LIMB.INC is a signal-like horror job simulator where you read the lives of lost souls and match their files to the objects that defined them. Interpret clues, make decisions, customize your desk, and survive the day in the worst job in the underworld.
